research_rationale: The full held OCR shows establishment, functions and reporting, agency support, FACA delegation and a Commission termination 30 days after its actual report unless extended. The March 9, 1989 reporting deadline is not proof of occurrence. The machine section 2 span incorrectly absorbs the garbled section 3 administration and section 4 Counsel-to-the-President command. Exact source spans below preserve those separate duties without supplying reconstructed text. Section 4 orders Counsel reports after the Commission report and therefore cannot automatically end with the Commission. EO:12692 section 3(c) expressly revokes the order with section 5 stated effect September 30, 1989; this is a potential later end for the independent command, not proof of the earliest end of Commission clauses. Missing actual report/extension evidence, materially garbled original OCR and the mandatory actor image check prevent approval.
